description: Run your short-term rentals on Guesty from your workflows: find, book, cancel and change reservations, message guests, block dates and set prices, and keep guests and tasks up to date. Start a workflow on a new, changed or cancelled reservation, a guest message or a review.

guesty_new_guest_message_trigger.description: Runs when a guest sends a message to your Guesty inbox, by any channel, with the conversation, reservation and listing it's about. Messages sent before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

output.channel: How it came in, such as airbnb2, email or sms
output.guest_email: The guest's email; empty if not shown
output.guest_name: The guest's name; empty if not shown
output.listing_id: The ID of the listing it's about
output.reservation_id: The ID of the reservation it's about

parameters.description: Only messages about stays for this listing. Leave blank for every listing.
parameters.name: listing

guesty_new_reservation_trigger.description: Runs when a reservation or inquiry is added to Guesty, with its dates, guest, listing and conversation. Choose a status, such as confirmed, to run only for those: an inquiry that's confirmed later starts it then. Reservations already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.adults: How many adults; empty if not given
output.canceled_at: When it was cancelled (ISO 8601); empty if not shown
output.channel: The channel it was booked through
output.check_in: The check-in date in the listing's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.check_in_at: When the guest is due to arrive (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.check_out: The check-out date in the listing's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.check_out_at: When the guest is due to leave (ISO 8601, UTC)
output.children: How many children; empty if not given
output.confirmed_at: When it was confirmed (ISO 8601); empty if not shown
output.conversation_id: The ID of its guest conversation, for sending messages; empty if not shown
output.guest_id: The ID of the guest who booked
output.infants: How many infants; empty if not given
output.key_code: The door or key code kept on it
output.listing_id: The ID of the listing it's for
output.nights: How many nights the stay is
output.pets: How many pets; empty if not given
output.source: Where it came from, such as airbnb, booking.com or manual
output.status: Its status as Guesty stores it, such as confirmed, inquiry or canceled
output.status_label: Its status as Guesty shows it

parameters.description: Only reservations in this status, such as confirmed. Leave blank for every new reservation.
